Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 26-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS & COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING) EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 3122/ECE_3122 - MICROPROCESSORS  
  MICROPROCESSORS [ECE 3122]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                        Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data if any may be sutably assumed  
  
1A)               With a neat diagram, compare the Harvard and Von-Neumann architecture of computing systems.                 (4)  
1B)               Demonstrate the following assembler directives with suitable example:                                       (3)  
  i) AREA directive along with its 4 important attributes  
  ii) EXPORT  
1C)               With a timing diagram, show how the following code is executed in ARM7 using the concept of 3-              (3)  
  stage pipeline. Discuss how many cycles are required for the execution of the following code.  
  
  MOV R4, R5  
  ADD R1, R2, R3  
  SUB R6, R7, R8  
2A)                                                                                                                           (4)  
  Describe the function of the following ARM7 instructions in detail. Assuming the same PRE-condition  
  for all instructions, write the POST conditions of the affected registers and flags for each instruction.  
  
  
  i) RSB R5, R2, R0, LSR #10  
  ii) EORS R6, R1, R7, ROR #4  
  iii. ADC R7, R2, R3, LSR #4  
  iv) LDRSB R8, [R0], #4  
2B)               Describe the functions of following ARM instructions in detail with example. Identify the type of           (3)  
  addressing mode and state whether the instructions manipulate the flag bits or not.  
  i) SMLAL R3, R5, R6, R8  
  ii) STMIB R1!, {R1-R4}  
  iii) RSCS R0, R81, R7, LSR #8  
2C)                                                                                                                                 (3)  
  
  
  Page 1 of 2

3A)   Write an ARM 7 assembly language program to find the second largest number in the array of fifteen (4)  
  32-bit numbers stored in the memory and store the result in the memory.  
3B)   Encode the following data processing instruction into a 32-bit operation code and explain function of   (3)  
  each field in the code:  
  ADDS R1, R0, R2, LSR #2  
3C)   Discuss the main advantages of defining AAPCS in ARM 7. Explain in detail with relevant diagram.        (3)  
4A)   Draw the interfacing diagram of 2x16 LCD to PORT0 and an analogue input voltage of range 0-3V to (4)  
  P0.28 of LPC2148. Write an embedded C program that displays the input voltage on the LCD.  
  Explain the logic with suitable comments.  
4B)   Describe the functionality of the port pins for the following C statements:                             (3)  
  $$i) IO0DIR = (1< < 3);$$  
  $$ii) IO0DIR | = 0x00000008;$$  
  $$iii) IO0DIR | = (1< < 3);$$  
4C)   Draw the pin connect diagram of LPC2148 by showing the PORT pin used when                               (3)  
  PINSEL0=0x00000C. Give the functionality highlighting its role.  
5A)   Describe the re-entrant interrupt handler with relevant flow diagram.                                   (4)  
5B)   Describe the method of enabling and disabling the interrupts in ARM 7 processor with relevant code. (3)  
5C)   Draw the memory map diagram of Cortex M3. Calculate the bit-band alias address of 7th bit of the        (3)  
  bit-band byte at the address 0x4002000F, in Cortex M3.  
  
  
  -----End-----  
  
  
  Page 2 of 2
